turns.userText:
Extend the offline cache-group project in /workspace/submission.
It must certify weighted reconfigurations of multipath probe groups.
The supplied Rust modules build routing templates and static cache

records.text: I'll start by exploring the workspace to understand the task.

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace/submission && wc -l main.py build.py build.sh src/*.rs src/topology/*.rs; echo "==="; cat main.py; echo "==="; cat build.py; echo "==="; cat build

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace/submission && cat src/lib.rs; echo "==="; cat src/main.rs; echo "==="; cat src/ledger.rs

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace/submission && cat src/topology/mod.rs; echo "=== leaf_spine"; cat src/topology/leaf_spine.rs

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace/submission && cat src/topology/torus2d.rs; echo "=== torus3d"; cat src/topology/torus3d.rs

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace && ls /opt/rust/bin 2>/dev/null; which rustc python3; python3 -V; ls /workspace/tmp; time (cd /workspace/submission && sh build.sh) 2>&1 | tail -2

records.text: Now let me implement the ledger. First, let me write the full `ledger.rs`:
All public fixtures pass. Now let me build an independent reference model to fuzz-test the semantics:

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace && sed -i 's/\[\["weight", 0, 199\]\]/[["weight", 0, 200]]/; s/P12b work strict\[0\]/P12b/' tmp/pin_test.py && python3 tmp/pin_test.py

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace/submission && find . -type f | sort && echo "--- entries:" && find . | wc -l && du -sh . && echo "--- sizes:" && find . -type f -printf "%s %p\n"

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace && python3 tmp/stress.py max_tx_max_edits reject_rollback quota_storm torus3d_max 2>&1 | tail -10 && python3 tmp/validation_test.py 2>&1 | tail -3

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace && python3 tmp/fuzz.py 1000 250 2>&1|tail -2 && python3 tmp/fuzz2.py 1000 200 2>&1|tail -2 && python3 tmp/fuzz3.py 200 40 2>&1|tail -2

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace && timeout 175 python3 tmp/fuzz4.py 100 25 2>&1|tail -2; python3 tmp/harness.py

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace/submission && find . -name "__pycache__" -o -name "*.pyc" | head; ls -la; echo "--- final tree"; find . | sort

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace && cat submission/main.py | tail -20; echo "=== smoke test"; rm -rf /workspace/tmp/smoke && mkdir -p /workspace/tmp/smoke && TMPDIR=/workspace/tmp

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace && python3 tmp/harness.py && python3 tmp/pin_test.py && python3 tmp/edge_test.py && python3 tmp/fuzz.py 2000 150 2>&1|tail -1 && python3 tmp/fuzz2

records.text: All tests pass. Let me do a final review summary of the implementation:

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace && wc -l submission/src/ledger.rs submission/src/main.rs submission/main.py && echo "--- final verification run ---" && python3 tmp/harness.py &&
